xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. The above Consolidated financial results of EAAA India Alternatives Limited ('the Company') and its subsidiaries (together referred to as 'Group') for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 are reviewed and recommended by the Audit committee and have been approved by the Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on November 11, 2026.
2.The Company completed its Initial Public Offering ("IPO") of equity shares comprising of offer for sale of 72,07,207 equity shares of face value Rs. 5 each at an issue price of Rs. 1665 per share. Pursuant to the IPO, the equity shares of the Company were listed on BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited on November 2, 2026. Accordingly, the financial results are being submitted pursuant to Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended.
3. The figures for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025 are the balancing figures between reviewed figures in respect of half year ended September 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025 and reviewed figures for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 and June 30, 2025 respectively.
4. The decrease in Other expenses in the quarter ended September 30, 2026 as compared to the quarter ended June 30, 2026, is primarily attributable to the higher amortization of the Selling and Distribution expenses on account of realisation of Variable Additional Return in a fund in the previous quarter.
5. The Company operates in a single reportable segment of Investment manager to Alternative Investment Funds and Advisory services to offshore funds business as per the requirement of Ind AS 108 - Operating Segment.
6. During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, Company has alloted 3,75,000 equity shares of Rs. 5 each pursuant to exercise of stock options under ‘EAAA India Employee Stock Option Scheme 2024’ by certain employees.
7. The Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 11, 2026 have approved an interim dividend of Rs. 7 per equity share.
8. Figures for the previous quarter have been regrouped/reclassified wherever necessary to conform to current quarter presentation.
